$comment: When multi-package (npm workspaces): the canonical scripts that take another form. "scripts" replace the root scripts of the same name in package-scripts.json (every other root script stays as it is). "workspaceScripts" go into every workspace's own package.json, because the root runs them with --workspaces. "appScripts" go into every Expo app workspace's package.json: the root export:audit runs the app's own one, so expo export runs inside the app (Metro finds the app's entry there; from the root it looks for the single-app entry and fails) and writes the export to dist-audit at the repo root, where audit:licenses and the bundle audit read it. "../../" is the way up from apps/<app>. check-gate-wiring.mjs (quality-gates) and check-skeleton.mjs (expo-project-bootstrap) read this file when package.json has workspaces.

appScripts.export:audit: APP_VARIANT=production EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT=production expo export --platform ios --platform android --source-maps --output-dir ../../dist-audit
